properties.snippet:
The coverage is used to fulfill the requirement of Kentucky Revised Statute section 278.017 that the Kentucky Public Service Commission (PSC) prepare a map or maps of uniform scale to show the certified service territories of all retail electric suppliers in Kentucky. The positions of service area boundaries are estimated to be accurate within 100 feet.  These digital boundaries are for informational purposes only, and have
no legal standing.
properties.description: This is a coverage of the service areas of electric suppliers in the state of Kentucky. The polygon attribute table identifies the service territories; the arc attribute table gives the regulatory classification of boundary segments. The establishment of geographical service areas for retail electric suppliers, the rights of utilities operating within their own territories, and the requirement of map submission to the Kentucky Public Service Commission (PSC) are provided for in Kentucky Revised Statute (KRS) sections 278.016 to 278.020. The certified territory maps are the legal documents that define the retail electric service area of electric suppliers regulated by the Commission (Kentucky Statute 278.017). All of these maps are on file at the PSC. They have been scanned and are available as PDF documents. Most of them are USGS topographic maps from the 1980s signed by both utilities and stamped by the Public Service Commission. These were used to compile this coverage. The positions of service area boundaries on this coverage are estimated to be accurate within 100 feet. These digital boundaries are for informational purposes only, and have no legal standing.

properties.snippet: This layer filters the location of alternative fueling stations for Kentucky. Data is from the US Department of Energy's National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) and is updated daily.
properties.description:
This layer displays the location of alternative fuel stations across the U.S. and Canada filtered for Kentucky.. Alternative fuel sources include biodiesel, compressed natural gas, electric, ethanol, hydrogen, liquefied natural gas, propane and renewable diesel. Attributes include the station name, location, access, hours and more. Zoom into the map for more detail.
This data is maintained by an Aggregated Live Feed routine that accesses the US Department of Energy's National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) API website.
 
Source: NREL Alternate Fuel Stations (ALL)
 
 
Update Frequency: The service data is refreshed once Daily
 
Area Coverage: Contiguous US, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and Canada.
 
Coordinate System: Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere (3857)
 
Layer Summary:
  • Stations: Point layer containing locations of all Alternate Fueling Stations
Reporting station changes
  1. Leverage the NREL Alternate Fueling Station Locator to narrow your search and Map Results. Next, click on a station and hit 'Report a change' to start the request process. It may take some time for the source to apply the update!
  2. Add a comment to this item with the Station ID plus required changes and we will update our service content as quickly as possible once reviewed.
Revisions
  • May 9, 2025: Added guidance for reporting station changes.
  • Dec 27, 2024: Enabled Time Series capability using 'Date Fuel Available' field. Default state is inactive, you must turn property on in map layer to use.
     
  • Mar 17, 2023: Released to the public!
     

This layer is provided for informational purposes and is not monitored 24/7 for accuracy and currency.

 

If you would like to be alerted to potential issues or simply see when this Service will update next, please visit our Live Feed Status Page
